summary: A request, to any signer, to sign a Hyperliquid L1 action (orders, cancels, leverage). The typed data holds only connectionId, a hash of the action, so the request must carry the action in x-signed-payload: it must hash to what is signed, and is then typed as the /exchange request it is. Testnet actions are refused: testnet numbers its assets differently.

actions.refuse: a testnet action: testnet numbers its assets differently, so it is not typed
typed data of this domain other than an L1 action is not typed
